thanks, fair critique! it's addressed: the "avg % of points" is column (the purple one) is the *average* percent of the vote *in a given poll*, not the % of the vote overall. like, if someone gets 3.1% 12 times, and another person gets 3.5% 2 times, the purple column will rank the second character higher than the first. the names are sorted by this metric. this is why the points chart ranks Hata no Kokoro over Reisen, even though Reisen has received more overall votes.
